name: AlertWise: The Best Mobile & Web Push Notification Service
author: alertwise

sections.description: AlertWise is a powerful push notification plugin that helps you engage users in real time.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the Plugins section and click Add New.
  3. Search for the plugin by name in the search bar, or click Upload Plugin to upload a plugin ZIP file from your computer.
  4. Click Install Now next to the plugin you want to add.
  5. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin on your site.
  6. After activation, look for the plugin’s menu (such as AlertWise) in your WordPress admin sidebar to configure settings or connect your account as needed.
